title: Unbounded identity-open compact support for a closed immersion
statement:
Fix the finite coefficient datum of [def-pur-conventions], with $A=A_{E,n}$. Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion of separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism]. Work in the ordinary unbounded derived categories $D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ of constant-$A$ module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Write $F_0=i_{\mathrm{et},*}$ for direct image on module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], and $Q_T$ for localization of complexes at quasi-isomorphisms. The functor $F_0$ is exact. Its termwise application descends to a functor $F:D(Z_{\mathrm{et}},A)\to D(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ normalized by $FQ_Z\cong Q_XF_0$. For $c=(\operatorname{id}_Z,i)$ and ordinary etale compact support [def-amb-etale-compact-support], there are canonical natural isomorphisms
$$Ri_!^c\xrightarrow{\sim}Ri_{\mathrm{et},*}\xrightarrow{\sim}F$$
on the whole unbounded category. The first removes identity extension by zero [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero]; the second is the inverse of the total right-derived comparison, which is invertible on every representing complex. Under these identifications, for every $V\in D(Z_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and every integer $m$,
$$H^m(FV)\cong F_0(H^m(V)),$$
naturally in $V$. Thus $F$ preserves both cohomological lower and upper bounds. No constructibility or boundedness hypothesis is imposed on $V$.

proof.text: A closed immersion is finite by the Mathlib IsFinite instance for IsClosedImmersion (Morphisms/Finite.lean). Apply the already proved constant-module finite-direct-image exactness instance preservesFiniteColimits_lowerStar_of_isFinite of [lemma-weil-pbc-finite-direct-image-exact]; lowerStar preserves finite limits as a right adjoint. Set F = lowerStar (ModuleCat P.Coefficient) i.

Choose phi = F.mapDerivedCategoryFactors from [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization]. Use the proved source right-derived comparison F.rightDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory (WeilConjectures/CategoryTheory/DerivedCategory/RightDerivedFunctor/MapDerivedCategory.lean), the construction underlying the finite specialization in [lemma-weil-pbc-finite-direct-image-exact]. Its hom_fac theorem is exactly the required unit normalization equation, and its isIso_rightDerivedFunctorUnit instance proves invertibility on every representing complex. This reuses the existing homotopy-category right-derived uniqueness proof rather than constructing another Kan-extension comparison.

At the proper compactification ofIsProper i, [def-amb-etale-compact-support] is definitionally identity-open derived extension by zero followed by the total right derived F. Choose e to be precisely isoWhiskerRight (mapDerivedCategoryOpenImmersionLowerShriekId _ Z) F.rightDerivedFunctor followed by the left unitor. The source identity-open isomorphism is built by uniqueness of left adjoints, then exact termwise derivation. Its required normalization is reflexivity. Properness follows by instances from the finiteness of i; no Noetherian argument is needed by the existing definition.

Apply the inverse of F.mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso in every integer degree. This is the natural functor isomorphism of [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-bounded-below], already descended through localization in the source library. For each lower or upper bound install the corresponding hypothesis and apply F.isGE_mapDerivedCategory_obj or F.isLE_mapDerivedCategory_obj. Both lemmas work for arbitrary unbounded objects and use no constructibility.
